cond_0252.responsibilities:
Work alongside the IT Finance Manager in day-to-day IT Finance operations.
Build and maintain strong relationships with IT Leaders to help coordinate and monitor the accuracy of financial data across all [Company name masked] IT/HTM cost centers.
Analyze financial data for all [Company name masked] IT/HTM cost centers and prepare reports for IT leaders and managers as required.
Support the IT Finance Manager in completing and compiling financial documentation for budget and external audit purposes.
Coordinate with IT Leaders and other project owners to help ensure capital project and operational spending is on track, forecasts are correct, and completed capital projects are being depreciated timely.

Facilitate monthly/quarterly budget review meetings with IT Leaders to jointly evaluate spending across all [Company name masked] IT/HTM cost centers, and share findings with the IT Finance Manager.
Leadership: Show curiosity and raise questions about how IT Finance processes may be improved. Assist the Manager in hiring new team members. Help team members align their efforts with departmental and organizational goals. Support process improvement for team turnaround times. Continue self-education to stay current in finance and accounting practices, and share that knowledge to provide guidance to team members.

Support process improvement for team turnaround times. Encourage team collaboration. Help develop new processes and procedures and ensure team members apply them consistently. CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The statements described here are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed by people assigned to this position. They are not intended to be constructed as an all-inclusive list of all responsibilities and duties. Other duties may be assigned.
Assists the IT Finance Manager in day to day IT Finance operations.
Cultivates strong relationships with IT Leaders to help coordinate and monitor the accuracy of financial data across all [Company name masked] IT/HTM cost centers.
Analyzes financial data for all [Company name masked] IT/HTM cost centers and create reports for IT leaders and managers as required.
Provides support to IT Finance manager in completing and compiling financial support documentation for budget and external audit purposes.
Works with IT Leaders and other project owners to ensure capital project and operational spending is on track, forecasts are correct, and completed capital projects are being depreciated timely.

Facilitates and leads monthly/quarterly budget review meetings with IT Leaders to evaluate spending across all [Company name masked] IT/HTM cost centers and reports finding to the IT Finance Manager.
Leadership: Demonstrates curiosity and questions how IT Finance processes may be improved. Assist Manager in hiring new team members. Ensure team members focus their efforts toward departmental and organizational goals and objectives. Implements process improvement for team turnaround times. Continues self-education to remain up-to-date in finance and accounting practices; then uses the knowledge to provide insight and guidance to team members.
Team Building and Training: Provides onboarding and training of new hires. Facilitates training sessions for team. Mentors team members concerning finance, accounting and customer service skills. Implements process improvement for team turnaround times. Encourages team collaboration. Develops new process and procedures and ensures team members perform the same with consistency. Creates a participative, collaborative work environment. Encourages team collaboration and cohesiveness.

Bachelor of Science in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred. Alternatively, a minimum of four (4) years of demonstrated expertise in a directly relevant role.

Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
